sentences.en: and felt incredibly awkward in the days and the weeks that have followed.

sentences.zh: 这到底源于哪里？

sentences.en: Where does this come from?

sentences.zh: 从而避免透露超出我们舒适范围的信息。

sentences.en: and maybe disclosing more than we are comfortable with.

sentences.zh: 到底什么是过度分享？

sentences.en: What exactly is oversharing?
sentences.zh: 我想我们对过度分享的含义都有直观的感受，正如我所说，回想起某次对话，

sentences.en: I think we all have an intuitive idea of what it means to overshare, to look back at a conversation, as I said,
sentences.zh: 然后突然意识到，这个人现在对我们的了解可能远超出了我们的舒适区。

sentences.en: and just realise that this person now probably knows a lot more about us than we are comfortable with.
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，过度分享是指在错误的对象面前或在错误的时间，透露了不合时宜的大量个人生活细节的倾向。

sentences.en: Essentially, to overshare is a tendency to disclose an inappropriate amount of detail about our life to the wrong person or at the wrong time.
sentences.zh: 我有过这种经历，比如在派对或工作活动上喝得有点微醺，突然吐露了某个深埋心底的童年秘密，

sentences.en: I've been there, you know, being a bit too drunk at a party or a work event and suddenly revealing some deep childhood secret
sentences.zh: 或者说了一些关于你朋友、你明知不该分享的事情。

sentences.en: or something about your friend that you know you shouldn't have shared.
sentences.zh: 这种倾向有诸多成因。

sentences.en: And that tendency comes from a lot of places.
sentences.zh: 有时是社交焦虑，在某些情况下感到极其紧张，以至于你试图寻找任何东西或任何方法来与他人建立联系。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's social anxiety, just feeling so nervous in certain situations that you just try and find anything or any way to connect with others.
sentences.zh: 或者你之所以过度分享，是因为你的焦虑降低了你的社交防线或冲动控制能力。

sentences.en: Or you overshare because your anxiety has lowered your filter or your impulse control.
sentences.zh: 还有一些与神经多样性相关的解释，我们稍后会简要探讨。

sentences.en: There's also explanations to do with neurodivergence that we're going to touch on a little bit later.
sentences.zh: 也有可能只是因为你觉得自己不够优秀或很无聊，于是你搬出自己最尴尬的故事、最脆弱的时刻，

sentences.en: And also it might just be because you feel inadequate or boring and you're looking to your most embarrassing story, your most vulnerable moments
sentences.zh: 来填补社交场合中的某种空虚，让自己显得更有趣。

sentences.en: to kind of fill a void in a social situation and make you feel more interesting.
sentences.zh: 这也是一种加速关系进展的方式，让人们在超出正常节奏的时间线上感觉与你更亲近，或者仅仅是因为我们感到孤独。

sentences.en: It also is a way to speed up relationships, to make people feel closer to you on an advanced timeline or just because we feel lonely.
sentences.zh: 当我们觉得人际关系缺乏深度或感到疏离时，我们往往会下意识地把过度分享当作一种手段，通过提升情感亲密的深度来建立新的纽带。

sentences.en: When we feel like our relationships don't have much depth or we're feeling detached, we can use oversharing often subconsciously as a means to create new bonds
sentences.zh: 抛开原因不谈——因为我们一会儿会更深入地探讨——长期过度分享，也就是反复分享过多细节的习惯和行为，

sentences.en: by escalating that depth of emotional intimacy.
sentences.zh: 也会给我们带来许多懊悔和尴尬，导致我们陷入负面自我对话，告诉自己说，

sentences.en: I think reasons aside, because we'll talk about them more in depth in a second, chronic oversharing, the repeated habit and behaviour of sharing too much detail,
sentences.zh: 我们真该闭嘴，自己真是太让人脚趾抠地了，别人一定觉得我很怪。

sentences.en: it can also cause us a lot of regret and embarrassment, leading us to engage in some negative self-talk, telling ourselves that, you know,
sentences.zh: 我不认为你理应承受这种感受，或者对自己进行这种内心的否定。

sentences.en: we should just shut up and that we're cringe and that people think we're weird.
sentences.zh: 我认为这与其说是关于你给别人留下的印象，

sentences.en: And I don't think that you deserve to feel that way or to have that internal dialogue about yourself.
sentences.zh: 不如说是关于这让你如何看待自己——这其实是过度分享的次要后果。

sentences.en: I think it's less about the impression you're making on other people.
sentences.zh: 有一点很重要，需要记住：大多数人在过度分享时，其实都抱着最好的初衷。

sentences.en: I think that is a secondary consequence of oversharing and more about how it makes you feel about yourself.
sentences.zh: 作为人类，我们经常把故事和个人倾诉作为建立联系、传达真实的自我、向人们真正展示我们核心面貌的一种方式。

sentences.en: It's an important thing to remember that most of us have the best intentions when it comes to oversharing.
sentences.zh: 在过度分享和保持真诚之间，往往存在着一条非常纤细、难以捉摸的界限。

sentences.en: As humans, we often use stories and personal disclosure as a way to build connection and to communicate our authentic selves, to really show people who we are at our core.
sentences.zh: 我想这条线有时很难看清，是因为这两种行为在当时的感觉非常相似。

sentences.en: And there's often this very thin, intangible line between oversharing and being authentic.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会挣扎于辨别什么是应该保持私密的，什么又是可以分享的，这不仅是对密友和家人，

sentences.en: And I think the reason why that line is sometimes hard to see is because both acts feel very similar in the moment.
sentences.zh: 还有对泛泛之交、同事甚至陌生人。

sentences.en: And we can kind of struggle to identify what is meant to be kept private and what can be shared, not just with close friends and family,
sentences.zh: 因此，真诚往往源于诚实和真实的核心。

sentences.en: but with acquaintances or co-workers or even strangers.
sentences.zh: 它关乎无论你面临着何种表现得体或循规蹈矩的压力，无论你面临着

sentences.en: So authenticity often comes from a very core place of honesty and realness.
sentences.zh: 必须看起来、表现得或行事如何的压力，都敢于分享真实的自我。

sentences.en: It's about not being afraid to share who you are regardless of the pressure you're under to do otherwise, regardless of the pressure you're under
sentences.zh: 这种真诚的一部分，就是对你的感受和经历保持开放和诚实。

sentences.en: to look or act or behave a certain way.

sentences.en: And part of that authenticity is being open and honest about your feelings and your experiences.
sentences.zh: 我想我们在网上经常看到这种现象。

sentences.en: Part of that is disclosure and sometimes making public what we often imagine to be private.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是最好的例子：那些我们认为最真诚的创作者或网红，通常也是最愿意

sentences.en: We see this online a lot, I would say.
sentences.zh: 分享自己个人细节的人。

sentences.en: That's like the best example I can think of where we have creators or influencers, the ones that we would call most authentic are normally those who are most willing
sentences.zh: 我想我们之所以称之为真诚，是因为真相、分享和脆弱能够建立共鸣和亲近感。

sentences.en: to share personal details about themselves.
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，我们可以看着他们说的话，看着他们的故事，并在那些时刻看到我们自己的影子。

sentences.en: And I think the reason why we call that authenticity is because truth and sharing and vulnerability, it builds relatability and it builds a sense of closeness.
sentences.zh: 我们看到自己亲身经历的事情在他们身上得到了反射，这让我们觉得自己不那么孤单了。

sentences.en: Essentially, we can look at the things they are saying, look at their stories and we see ourselves in those moments.
sentences.zh: 因此，从某种意义上说，有些人通常视为过度分享的行为，其实也具有不可思议的治愈效果，不仅对分享这些信息的人如此，对受众

sentences.en: We see what we are personally going through reflected back at us and that causes us to feel less alone.
sentences.zh: 或正在倾听的人也是如此。

sentences.en: So in that way, I think what some people may typically see as oversharing is also incredibly healing, not just for the person who is sharing this information, but for the audience
sentences.zh: 我认为我们对这种坦诚程度的接受，确实代表了

sentences.en: or those who are listening in.
sentences.zh: 我们社会在近几十年来，尤其是这一代人身上发生的一个相当显著的转变。

sentences.en: I think our acceptance of this level of candor really represents,
sentences.zh: 过去被视为禁忌的事情，现在变得越来越可以拿出来讨论，让大家知道，并将人们引入你生活的点点滴滴中，

sentences.en: I think, a pretty significant shift in our society that we've seen in recent decades, especially in this generation.
sentences.zh: 无论是好是坏。

sentences.en: where it has become more and more acceptable to discuss things that previously were taboo and to make them known and to bring people into the details of your life,
sentences.zh: 每当我想起这一点，脑海里就会立刻浮现出心理健康、性以及许多与我们个人生活息息相关的细节等话题。

sentences.en: the good and the bad.

sentences.en: And when I think about this, my mind immediately goes to topics like mental health, like sex, like a lot of details to do with our personal lives.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着我们整个社会变得更加开明，更能接受彼此展现脆弱的能力，有时这意味着过度分享。

sentences.en: These are no longer things to be shunned or shut away, but often at times shared in the public domain as we do on social media, as we do to create or consume authentic content.
sentences.zh: 有时这意味着它有点超越了人们感到舒适的界限。

sentences.en: And so as we as a society have become more liberal and more accepting of our capacity to be vulnerable with each other, sometimes that means oversharing.
sentences.zh: 我想这才是这里的核心所在。

sentences.en: Sometimes that means it's kind of breaching the level of what people are comfortable with.
sentences.zh: 不知从什么时候起，我们有时把真诚的想法与向全世界倾诉我们最深、最黑暗的秘密混淆了。

sentences.en: And I think that's the main point here.
sentences.zh: 我看到过一句精彩的名言，我认为它很好地阐释了真诚与过度分享、甚至极端情况下的“倾倒创伤”之间的区别。

sentences.en: Somewhere along the line, we have at times confused the idea of being honest with sharing our deepest, darkest secrets with the world.
sentences.zh: 它说的是：利用脆弱并不等于真正的脆弱。

sentences.en: And I saw this amazing quote that I think really demonstrates the difference between authenticity and oversharing or even at the extreme, you know, trauma dumping.
sentences.zh: 当不合时宜时，我们有时会把暴露自己私密的一面当作一种资源、一种工具，甚至几乎是一种情感盔甲，也许是为了加速建立关系。

sentences.en: And what it said was that using vulnerability is not the same thing as being vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 如果你听过我们关于遗弃问题的节目，你就会认出这是一种防御机制：我们通过过度展现脆弱，

sentences.en: for feeling overwhelmed or feeling triggered by past events.

sentences.en: So you feel the need to verbalize rather than process.

sentences.en: Or in some cases, and I don't think this is that common, sometimes we overshare or we, you know, use certain stories to gain sympathy unconsciously.

sentences.en: A lot of these reasons, though, are not intentional.

sentences.en: They are themselves a symptom of what we're going through or what we are finding difficult to manage.
sentences.zh: 我们就会向外求助。

sentences.en: Whether that is something from your childhood or a recent fight you had with a friend or a relationship issue, when we can't find emotional closure internally and by ourselves,
sentences.zh: 我们寄希望于他人，通过分享、获得不同的视角以及寻找某种形式的认可或反馈来帮我们实现这种闭环。

sentences.en: we look outwards.
sentences.zh: 我认为尤其是把社交媒体当成个人日记，或者把泛泛之交当成你的治疗师，这可能会产生严重的后果，

sentences.en: We look to others to give us that closure by sharing and gaining a different perspective and looking for a certain type of either validation or feedback.
sentences.zh: 不仅对你本人，也会对你与之交谈或分享的人以及你生活中其他重要的人产生影响。

sentences.en: I think in particular, treating social media somewhat like a personal diary or approaching acquaintances as if they are your therapist, that can have serious consequences

sentences.en: not just for you but also for the people that you speak to or you share with and other important people in your life.
sentences.zh: 离开他们的反馈，我们就无法调节自己的情绪反应。

sentences.en: Not only can it be bad for things like personal online privacy if you're sharing every detail but we can kind of become addicted to the validation that is provided by strangers
